handbook.goobymod.page.1:
GOOBY HANDBOOK

Welcome! Goobys are round companion rabbits who value patience, snacks, and gentle care above all.
handbook.goobymod.page.2:
BEFRIENDING

Offer a wild Gooby a Jar of Nutella. Pet and feed it to grow friendship from Stranger to Best Friend.
handbook.goobymod.page.3:
NEEDS & MOODS

Watch hunger, loneliness, sleepiness, and fear. Shift and look at your Gooby for a quick status line.
handbook.goobymod.page.4:
THE WHISTLE

Use it on Gooby to cycle Wander, Follow, and Stay. Use it in the air to call your nearest owned Gooby.
handbook.goobymod.page.5:
TRICK TRAINING

Sneak-use a Training Treat on Gooby to choose a trick. Use three treats, with short breaks, to earn three stars.
handbook.goobymod.page.6:
PERFORMING

Double-use an empty hand on Gooby to request the active trained trick. Sneak-use the whistle in air for the trick menu.
handbook.goobymod.page.7:
FRIENDSHIP TIERS

Buddy: warm waves. Friend: gifts, rides, and sprint tag-along. Best Friend: golden gifts and daily snuggles.
handbook.goobymod.page.8:
A HOME FOR GOOBY

Name a tag, then use it on a hutch near your Gooby to bind them. Add up to three wool bedding layers. Better beds restore more joy and may hold a morning gift.
handbook.goobymod.page.9:
LITTLE GOOBYS

Use Nutella on a placed cake near two adult Friend-tier Goobys. Their baby follows its parents and grows up in 1.5 days.
handbook.goobymod.page.10:
GOOBY'S WARDROBE

Equip a tagged hat, scarf or bowtie, and Tiny Satchel. Dye scarves in crafting or while worn. Four Shimmer Fluff unlock a permanent coat; sneak-brush to cycle.
handbook.goobymod.page.11:
CREATE EXPRESS

Mixer: 250 mB milk + 3 cocoa + sugar → Nutella. Spout: empty jar + 250 mB chocolate → Nutella. Stay near a running machine for cozy hum.
handbook.goobymod.page.12:
WILD GOOBYS & BURROWS

Rare shy Goobys roam flower forests, cherry groves, and meadows. Follow their distant call to a grass-covered burrow and starter cache. Nutella earns their trust.
handbook.goobymod.page.13:
GOOBYS AMONG THEMSELVES

Nearby Goobys greet, chase, share, and huddle for naps without ignoring commands. Sneak-bow twice while looking at yours; or jump three times near a happy Gooby.
handbook.goobymod.page.14:
TREASURE TRAILS

Equip a Tiny Satchel for four safe slots. As a Friend, sneak-show a carrot or cozy block while holding a Training Treat in the other hand. Best Friends may dig up map scraps; four reveal a cache.
handbook.goobymod.page.15:
GRAND POLISH

The illustrated handbook, accessibility options, bounded memories, quiet crowds, and addon API make this the stable 5.x home.
handbook.goobymod.page.16:
ONE LAST RULE

Commands should always feel kind. Protect the smile, respect Stay mode, and never ration ear scratches.

— Sonic0810
handbook2.goobymod.title: Gooby Handbook 2.0
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.1.title: Meet Your Gooby
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.1.body: Find a shy wild Gooby or offer a wild rabbit Nutella. Feed, pet, and give it time. A first tame grants this handbook; friendship grows from Stranger through Best Friend.
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.2.title: Care & Safety
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.2.body: Shift-look for mood, satisfaction, gifts, training, and outfit. Tamed Goobys bounce away mob attacks and escape hazards. Food, company, shelter, and sleep keep the smile bright.
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.3.title: Whistle & Tricks
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.3.body: The whistle cycles Wander, Follow, and Stay with visible icons. Training Treats teach Spin, High Five, Flop, or Speak to three stars. Sneak-whistle in air to choose; double-use empty hands to perform.
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.4.title: Hutch & Family
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.4.body: Bind a named hutch and add three wool comfort layers. Two adult Friend Goobys can welcome one baby per day with Nutella Cake. Babies follow parents, nap at the nest, and grow in 1.5 days.
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.5.title: Wardrobe & Satchel
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.5.body: Datapack-tagged hats, dyeable scarves, bowties, coats, and a Tiny Satchel follow every animation. Use an equipped satchel again to open four owner-only slots; removing it safely returns every item.
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.6.title: Wild & Social
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.6.body: Explore meadows, cherry groves, flower forests, and burrows. Goobys greet, chase, exchange gifts, bow, mirror happy jumps, and huddle for naps without overriding commands or danger.
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.7.title: Treasure Trails
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.7.body: Sneak-show a target to a Friend while holding a Training Treat. Follow the paw trail. Best Friends may find Torn Map Scraps; four craft a map to a generated cache. Ore seeking remains opt-in.
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.8.title: Access & Addons
handbook2.goobymod.chapter.8.body: Reduced Motion stops cosmetic motion; High-Contrast Bubbles improve reading. Every sound has subtitles and every whistle has an icon. Addons can extend hats by tag and speech through the stable 5.x API.
bubble.goobymod.seek_nothing: Nothing here. My nose still deserves a treat.
bubble.goobymod.nougat1: My nougat sluice back home fills three jars an hour!

bubble.goobymod.nougat5: My grandpa cranked the nougat sluice by hand. A hero!
bubble.goobymod.nougat6: When I'm rich, I'll build a nougat sluice here too. Right next to your bed!
bubble.goobymod.game1: In my mobile game I have a sparkle park!
bubble.goobymod.game2: I feel at home there — but it's nice here too!
bubble.goobymod.game3: My mobile game me has a house with a hot tub!

bubble.goobymod.game6: Mobile game Gooby jumps higher than me. But I'M more huggable!
bubble.goobymod.idle1: Am I round? Yes. Am I cute? OH YES.
bubble.goobymod.idle2: I've thought about Nutella three times today. Okay, fourteen times.
bubble.goobymod.idle3: My ears are not toys! …Okay, maybe a little.
bubble.goobymod.idle5: Know the difference between me and a pillow? I purr.
bubble.goobymod.idle6: Carrots are fine. But have you ever tried carrots WITH Nutella?
bubble.goobymod.idle7: I'm practicing my wave. How did it look? Be honest!
bubble.goobymod.idle8: Psst… I'm hiding an emergency snack around here. Tell no one!
bubble.goobymod.idle9: My belly wobbles when I hop. That's called PHYSICS.
bubble.goobymod.idle10: Pets are like Nutella: there is never enough.
bubble.goobymod.idle11: I once tried being grumpy. Lasted four seconds, then I had to smile.
bubble.goobymod.idle12: If you need me: I'll be wherever the petting is.
bubble.goobymod.rain2: Rain turns my fur into fluff mush.
bubble.goobymod.rain3: You know what helps against rain? Petting. Just saying.
bubble.goobymod.rain4: Clouds brought water. I brought indoor plans.
bubble.goobymod.night2: The stars sparkle almost as pretty as my sparkle park…
bubble.goobymod.night3: At night I dream of an ocean of Nutella… good night!
bubble.goobymod.night4: One last moon-hop, then the softest corner.
bubble.goobymod.cake2: I smell CAKE! Sharing is caring. Just for the record.
bubble.goobymod.cake3: That cake appears to have a Gooby-sized serving.
bubble.goobymod.cake4: I can guard the cake. Very, very closely.
bubble.goobymod.greet1: Hello there! I'm Gooby! Petting hours: ALWAYS.
bubble.goobymod.greet2: Ohhh, a visitor! I pre-warmed my belly for you!
bubble.goobymod.greet3: Wavey wave! You look like you could use a Gooby!
bubble.goobymod.greet4: Welcome! One scratch behind the ears please, that's the entry fee.
bubble.goobymod.pet3: Your hands were sent from petting heaven!
bubble.goobymod.pet4: More! I mean… if you have time. MORE!
bubble.goobymod.pet5: I'm officially your best friend now. No take-backs.
bubble.goobymod.eat2: My face fits PERFECTLY into the jar. That's destiny.
bubble.goobymod.eat3: Mmmmpf… nom… I'll share some. Maybe.
bubble.goobymod.eat4: Three jars an hour, I told you! Practice!
bubble.goobymod.sad1: Ow… why? I just wanted to cuddle… 🥺
bubble.goobymod.sad2: Boing! …It bounces right off. But my little heart heard it.
bubble.goobymod.sad3: I forgive you. Goobys hold no grudges. But 🥺.
bubble.goobymod.sad4: Let's try that moment again, but with gentler paws.
bubble.goobymod.dig3: The ground has secrets. My paws have questions.
bubble.goobymod.ride1: Hold on tight! Gooby Express, no brakes! Well… cuddle brakes!
bubble.goobymod.ride2: Giddy up! I'm hopping as fast as I can. Which is not very fast.
bubble.goobymod.ride3: Next stop: wherever the snacks are!
bubble.goobymod.wake1: Good morning! My hutch is the coziest spot in the world!
bubble.goobymod.convert1: POP! Here I am! Got any Nutella? Oh wait, you just had some!
bubble.goobymod.teleport1: Whew! Way too toasty over there!
bubble.goobymod.tamed1: You fed me NUTELLA! We're friends now. FOREVER.
bubble.goobymod.bestfriend1: BEST FRIENDS! You and me! And Nutella. Best THREE friends!
bubble.goobymod.cmd_wander: Freedom! I'll be over there. Or there. Or THERE!
bubble.goobymod.cmd_follow: Right behind you! Like a very round shadow!
bubble.goobymod.cmd_stay: I'll guard this exact spot. With my whole belly.
bubble.goobymod.gift1: For YOU! I dug it up myself!
bubble.goobymod.gift2: A present! Because you're my favorite!
bubble.goobymod.gift3: Shh, this one's from my secret stash!
bubble.goobymod.hungry1: My tummy says the Nutella hour is NOW.
bubble.goobymod.hungry2: Is that a jar I smell, or am I dreaming?
bubble.goobymod.hungry3: One tiny snack? For one very round Gooby?
bubble.goobymod.hungry4: My nose has filed an official Nutella request.
bubble.goobymod.lonely1: I saved this cuddle for you.
bubble.goobymod.lonely2: It is awfully quiet without my favorite person.
bubble.goobymod.lonely3: I'll wait right here. Mostly bravely.
bubble.goobymod.lonely4: Do you think my person misses me too?
bubble.goobymod.sleepy4: If I become a pillow, please tuck me in.
bubble.goobymod.scared2: Danger! Stay behind my very brave belly!
bubble.goobymod.scared3: Something hostile is coming this way!
bubble.goobymod.greet_buddy1: There you are, buddy! Wavey wave!
bubble.goobymod.greet_buddy2: Oh! I know you! Hi, buddy!
bubble.goobymod.greet_buddy3: Your favorite round acquaintance reporting in!
bubble.goobymod.greet_buddy4: Buddy spotted. Casual tail wiggle deployed.
bubble.goobymod.greet_friend1: My friend! I saved you the fluffiest hello.
bubble.goobymod.greet_friend2: I would follow that sprint anywhere!
bubble.goobymod.greet_friend4: You brought the familiar footsteps. I brought the bounce.
bubble.goobymod.greet_best_friend1: BEST FRIEND! My whole day just got warmer!
bubble.goobymod.greet_best_friend2: I knew those footsteps. I'd know them anywhere.
bubble.goobymod.greet_best_friend3: You came back! Emergency snuggle reserves: FULL.

bubble.goobymod.anniversary2: Remember our first pet? My ears certainly do.
bubble.goobymod.anniversary3: Seven days of us! I kept every happy memory.
bubble.goobymod.anniversary4: Our friendship has a whole week of extra fluff now.

bubble.goobymod.tier_up_best_friend: BEST FRIENDS! This deserves a golden heart!
bubble.goobymod.snuggle: Stay right there… maximum cozy achieved.

bubble.goobymod.baby5: I meant to do that tumble!
bubble.goobymod.baby6: Someday I will be extremely round.
